# One line per row: what is typed before Tab, then "|" where the cursor
# stands. A line that names a command the tree does not have yet ends in a
# tab and "waits <command>": run.sh skips it, and the Go test TestShellLines
# fails once the command is there, so that the line is made active.
#
# The commands
headscale |
headscale ve|
headscale api |
headscale debug h|
headscale completion |
headscale completion z|
headscale completion bash |
# Flags: long names only on a lone dash, a short typed in full completes
headscale -|
headscale version -|
headscale version --|
headscale version -c|
headscale api whoami --|
# Values, also in the --x= form
headscale -o |
headscale -o=|
headscale --output=j|
headscale debug health -o |
headscale version --output=|
# Files for a path flag
headscale -c |
headscale --config=|
headscale version --config |
# A flag given once is not offered again
headscale -o json -c x debug health --|
headscale version -o json --|
# The word after a value flag is its value
headscale -c -o |
headscale -c x ve|
# After a mistake Tab goes on from the last command understood, never files
headscale nodez |
headscale versoin --|
headscale version --bogus --|
headscale completion bash -c|
# Help and --version are ordinary flags on Tab
headscale -h ve|
headscale --version |
# Lines of the commands to come
headscale no|	waits nodes
headscale nodes |	waits nodes
headscale nodes routes ap|	waits nodes routes set
headscale -c x no|	waits nodes
headscale nodes list --|	waits nodes list
headscale nodes list -o |	waits nodes list
headscale nodes list --columns |	waits nodes list
headscale nodes list --columns id,na|	waits nodes list
headscale nodes list --columns=id,na|	waits nodes list
headscale nodes list --columns id,|	waits nodes list
headscale nodes list --sort la|	waits nodes list
headscale nodes list --sort -la|	waits nodes list
headscale nodes list --filter=ow|	waits nodes list
headscale policy set |	waits policy set
headscale check config |	waits check config
headscale nodes list |	waits nodes list
headscale nodes delete |	waits nodes delete
headscale nodes rm --f|	waits nodes delete
headscale nodes list -o=|	waits nodes list
headscale auth keys create alice --tags tag:p|	waits auth keys create
headscale auth keys create alice --tags tag:ci,tag:p|	waits auth keys create
headscale nodes list --config |	waits nodes list
headscale nodes list --config=|	waits nodes list
headscale nodes set 12 --name |	waits nodes set
headscale nodes routes |	waits nodes routes set
headscale nodes list --s|	waits nodes list
headscale nodes list -|	waits nodes list
headscale nodes list -c|	waits nodes list
headscale nodes list --bogus --l|	waits nodes list
headscale policy set --bogus |	waits policy set
headscale nodes list --sort id --s|	waits nodes list
headscale nodes list --filter id --f|	waits nodes list
headscale nodes delete o |	waits nodes delete
headscale nodes routes set 12 -- --|	waits nodes routes set
headscale nodes list --filter -ow|	waits nodes list
headscale nodes list --columns id,-ho|	waits nodes list
